principle: Migration is read-only over legacy evidence. It inventories the old coordination artifacts, selects at most one authoritative current record per work item, classifies the rest as evidence, generated view, superseded, or unknown, and proposes genesis work capsules that REFERENCE old evidence without rewriting it. No legacy artifact is deleted, overwritten, or reset; the destructive cutover and legacy-entrypoint replacement are owner-gated and out of scope here.

legacy_sources.note: Legacy Next.js Review/Approval Hub static export; replaced by the read-only Owner HUD.
Legacy session-recovery / continuity ledgers; superseded by the bounded wake protocol.
Read-only installation authority for the framework; not runtime state and not migrated.

work_items.note: Native runtime seed; already an authoritative work capsule.
The Review Hub is a projection, superseded by the HUD; no capsule is needed.
Proposed genesis capsule to track retiring the legacy continuity ledgers; stub only, not yet written.

rules.read_only: Every legacy_source disposition preserves or references the artifact; deletion, overwrite, and reset are never dispositions.
rules.one_authoritative_per_capsule: No two work items may claim the same new_capsule.
rules.migrated_has_capsule: A work item with status 'migrated' names an existing work capsule.
rules.proposed_is_a_stub: A work item with status 'proposed' names a capsule that does not yet exist.
rules.legacy_ref_resolves: A work item's legacy_ref is null or a declared legacy_source id.
